detail.releaseNotes:
Official Launch Time: 2026/06/03

Dear Spirimaster,

Soul Land: Awakening World—the first-ever 3D immersive MMORPG officially licensed by both the Soul Land anime and novel creators—is now live in Open Beta! Prepare yourself, because this time, we are completely revolutionizing the Soul Land universe!

The moment of awakening has arrived. Welcome to Soul Land. As your first Soul Power stirs, you are destined to stand at the center of the world and forge your own path to legend.

The traditional rules have been reshaped, bringing forth new opportunities. In this world, every forest, lake, unique Spirimon, and Spirit, alongside the legendary Seven Monsters and Spirit Temple Elders, will unfold their stories before you. Your journey to writing your own godhood epic begins here.

To celebrate the launch and show our appreciation for your anticipation and support for Soul Land: Awakening World, we have prepared a series of launch bonuses to assist you on your spirit-hunting journey.

Halos gleam, Ruins unfold—more features and surprises await your discovery in-game.
